Lebanese food is known for its vibrant flavours, balanced spices, and generous hospitality. Every dish we prepare is designed to bring the warmth and richness of Lebanon directly to your table. Leb Grill was founded by Amir , who in 2007 had a clear vision: to bring authentic grilled Lebanese food to London while maintaining the standards and flavours found in traditional Lebanese food. At the time, the idea of preparing food freshly to order in an area with limited footfall was met with scepticism. However, Amir remained committed to quality and authenticity. Our recipes and signature sauces are the result of more than 30 years of experience , refined over time to deliver the distinctive flavours that keep our customers coming back.
